registerFields.RequiredArtifact: Selected V1 branch: Branch B. Branch A: a public AI Party type and an authorization contract permitting only the Agents Service Principal to create hexa's deterministic provisioned Party under that type. Branch B: Parties Maintainer and Product formally accept the existing Organization-typed provisioned Party as the V1 launch contract, verified everywhere by its immutable deterministic id and never by type. Both branches require create-only AD-2 provisioning, idempotent exact retries, typed conflict for divergent identity/type requests, mandatory tenant scope, no tenant-role creation or replacement, and no Party PII in public results. The record must name the selected branch; absence of that decision is Uncommitted. Independently of the selected identity branch, Parties exposes a tenant-scoped authoritative resolution by PartyId returning stable Party classification (Human, Organization, or AI), active/liveness state, evidence position and observed instant, plus typed missing, ambiguous, stale, denied, and unavailable outcomes. For every human Party, the same seam also returns one stable non-PII AuthenticatedHumanActorId, HumanActorBindingVersion, validity interval, and queryable binding history sufficient to reproduce the identity in force at an action; it returns typed missing, ambiguous, stale, and overlapping-history outcomes. AD-8 uses both classification and binding at predefined-approver configuration and every runtime approver resolution; non-human Parties can never be Approvers, and a human command carrying a Party must bind to the same authenticated actor id.
